name: Casaroro Falls Trail
description: A popular 350-step descent leading to a dramatic 100-foot vertical waterfall nestled in a deep canyon gorge.

name: Mt. Talinis (Cuernos de Negros)
description: The second highest peak in Negros Oriental featuring volcanic lakes, mossy cloud forests, and sulfur vents.

name: Pulangbato Thermal Falls Trail
description: An easy scenic walk featuring natural sulfur-stained red rock cascades and thermal hot springs.

name: Balinsasayao Twin Lakes Nature Trail
description: Tranquil rainforest loop surrounding two pristine crater lakes, ideal for bird watching and kayaking.

name: Japanese Shrine Summit Trail
description: A historic ridge trail offering panoramic views of Dumaguete City and Siquijor Island across the sea.

name: Lake Danao Ridge Walk
description: A lush perimeter path hugging the smaller twin crater lake surrounded by protected virgin forest.

name: Apo Island Coastal Marine Trail
description: An island coastal walk leading to the historic lighthouse and volcanic rock formations overlooking coral reefs.

name: Bais Mangrove Forest Boardwalk
description: An elevated wooden trail traversing hundreds of hectares of protected mangrove ecosystems.

name: Niludhan Falls Eco-Walk
description: A short curtain waterfall walk with a wide 25-meter cascade surrounded by tropical foliage.

name: Mt. Kanlaon Southern Slope Trail
description: An intense trek through active volcanic terrain, pine ridges, and high-altitude cloud forests.

name: Bacong Highland Ridge Loop
description: Scenic agricultural upland trail overlooking coastal coconut groves and Tañon Strait.

name: Balerte Sulfur Vents Walk
description: A geothermal trail showcasing active steaming fumaroles and geothermal river vents.

name: Dauin Marine Sanctuary Beach Trail
description: A relaxing shoreline trek connecting coastal biodiversity reserves and dive spots.

name: Manjuyod Sandbar Low-Tide Trail
description: A unique shallow sea-walk accessible during low tide along a 7-kilometer white sand bar.

name: Baslay Hot Springs Trail
description: An upland eco-community trail passing volcanic hot springs and organic coffee farms.

name: Okiot River Canyon Walk
description: An adventurous river-trekking trail through carved limestone canyons and natural pools.
